newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian census puts population at 2.5 million.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian census puts population at 2.5 million.

text.p: The Palestinian Department of Statistics put the Arab population of the West Bank, Gaza Strip and Arab East Jerusalem at 2.53 million people in its 1996 census released on Wednesday.

Statistics Department head Hassan Abu Libdeh said there were 1.57 million Palestinians living in the West Bank, including Arab East Jerusalem. Abu Libdeh said 254,000 Palestinians lived in East Jerusalem and its outskirts.
He said there were 963,000 Palestinians living in the densely populated Gaza Strip.
"These are the official figures that should be used for the Palestinian population," he said.
Abu Libdeh said the census, which his department carried out over the past two years, was the second Palestinian population count that did not depend on Israeli figures.
He said the first was conducted in 1994 shortly after the establishment of Palestinian self-rule in parts of the West Bank and Gaza, which Israel seized in the 1967 Middle East war.
Abu Libdeh projected the Palestinian population would reach 3.13 million by the year 2000.
